# Cybergaar — Full content overview

Cybergaar provides cyber security assurance services. The focus is evidence-led security
work: security audits, ISO 27001 implementation, application security testing,
vulnerability scanning, and penetration testing.

## Home

See every gap. Secure every move. Cybergaar helps businesses understand and reduce cyber
risk through focused security audits, penetration testing and vulnerability scanning.

Industries covered: financial services, healthcare, technology and SaaS, public sector,
retail and eCommerce, and critical infrastructure.

Common services people search for:

- ISO audit and ISO 27001 implementation
- Application security testing
- Vulnerability scanning
- Penetration testing
- Cyber Essentials and PCI DSS readiness
- Cloud security review

## Global standards

Cybergaar helps teams connect cyber security and compliance frameworks to practical work.
Frameworks include ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials, Cyber Essentials Plus, SOC 2, PCI DSS,
GDPR, NIST CSF, HIPAA, DORA, NIS2, and regional standards across North America, South
America, Europe, Asia, Asia Pacific, the Middle East, and Africa.

## Services

### Audit and compliance

- PCI DSS — readiness and implementation for organisations processing card payments.
- ISO 27001 — ISMS readiness, gap assessment, control evidence and certification support.
- SOC 2 (Type I / Type II) — control design and evidence for SaaS and technology companies.
- Cyber Essentials — UK baseline certification readiness.
- Cyber Essentials Plus — UK independently tested baseline controls readiness.
- GDPR Compliance — data protection readiness and remediation.
- ISO 42001 (AI Management) — AI management system readiness and governance.
- HIPAA — US healthcare compliance readiness.
- HITRUST — healthcare assurance framework readiness.
- NIST CSF / 800-53 — control alignment and gap assessment.
- FedRAMP — US federal cloud readiness support.
- DORA — EU financial operational resilience readiness.
- NIS2 — EU essential and important entity readiness.
- SAMA Cyber Security Framework — Saudi Arabia financial sector readiness.
- CMMC — US defence industrial base readiness.
- CCPA / CPRA — California privacy readiness.

### Vulnerability scanning

- Network vulnerability scanning
- Web application vulnerability scanning
- Host-based vulnerability scanning
- Database vulnerability scanning
- Authenticated (credentialed) scanning
- Unauthenticated (non-credentialed) scanning
- Cloud-native vulnerability scanning

### Penetration testing

- Network penetration testing
- Web application penetration testing
- Mobile app penetration testing
- Cloud infrastructure penetration testing
- Social engineering penetration testing
- Wireless network penetration testing
- IoT / embedded systems penetration testing

## Solutions

Practical programmes that turn findings into stronger controls, better visibility and
continuous resilience: assurance readiness, attack surface clarity, secure product
delivery, and continuous resilience.

## Case studies

Representative engagements in financial services, healthcare, and SaaS covering security
